objective: Prove floor closure through runtime trajectory evidence, harden deterministic repository regression prerequisites, and gate Ascalon learning on independently verified production outcomes.

rulesConsidered: Intelligence proposes; authority authorizes; runtime executes; evidence proves.
F07 remains independent final verification and release authority.
A handoff contract does not constitute closed-loop proof.
Unverified, synthetic, or partial trajectories are ineligible for Ascalon training.
Observability may record process telemetry but does not grant authority.

notes: The collector intentionally marks handoff-only events as HANDOFF_CONTRACT and verified=false.
A fully verified trajectory requires all eight canonical floors, evidence references and zero authority violations.
The learning bridge records only outcome/process telemetry; no model chain-of-thought is stored.
OpenTelemetry research supports combining spans for duration-bearing operations with events for point-in-time checkpoints/outcomes.
F00-F05 live Overseer tasks now emit RUNTIME proof receipts derived from actual execution outputs; F06/F07 use PHYSICAL_VERIFIER proof.
Full training eligibility requires all eight canonical floors plus independent F07 physical verification.
dispositionRationale: The change extends existing governance and observability architecture, adds fail-closed trajectory evaluation, and keeps Ascalon downstream of independent verification. CI evidence is pending for the current head.
